## Technical Skills

- **Programming:** R, MATLAB, Python, Stata, SPSS, shell scripting.
- **Machine learning & AI:** classification, regression, clustering, PCA,
  explainable AI, boosting/bagging, neural networks.
- **Biostatistics:** survival and time-to-event analysis, hypothesis testing,
  multivariate analysis.
- **Data science:** data wrangling and feature engineering, web scraping and APIs,
  spatial data science, reproducible workflows with Git and Quarto.
- **Languages:** English, Urdu, Punjabi.
